applies_to.quote: These Directions shall be applicable to Urban Co-operative Banks (hereinafter collectively referred to as ‘UCBs’ and individually as a ‘UCB’).

answer.action: Urban Co-operative Banks must implement the concurrent audit system, conduct annual board reviews, and ensure quarterly investment certification submissions.
